summary: Digital partition layout: the committed routed block GDS from flow/pnr_tmds_encoder.py (OpenROAD P&R, then in-process DEF->GDS merge). Regeneration is NOT claimed and was NOT re-run for this attestation: the gf180mcu_fd_sc_mcu9t5v0 std-cell library and the pinned openroad/orfs image are absent on the attesting host. What is documented (layout/README.md, tmds_encoder section) is that a re-run of the P&R stage reproduced the routed DEF byte-identically; the DEF->GDS merge was not re-verified byte-for-byte. Provenance is documented, not byte-reproduced here.
